{{Quote|There are far more people on this ship&mdash;more ''slaves''&mdash;than there are Yuuzhan Vong. We can take them if we're together.|Kaye Galfridian|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 3" />}}
During the [[25 ABY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a '''revolt''' took place aboard the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[slaveship]] [[Heart of Artorias|''Tsam P'ah'']]. Aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] were thousands of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], taken from many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] by the Yuuzhan Vong. These prisoners were to be used as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on the [[Battle of Artorias|conquered]] planet [[Artorias]]. On Artorias' surface, the [[Artorias resistance]] had [[Death/Legends|killed]] many Yuuzhan Vong guards, and replacements were required from the ''Tsam P'ah''. When many of the slaveship's guards were sent to the planet's surface, the prisoners saw an opportunity to revolt. Artorian [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kaye Galfridian]] and a captured warrior, [[Arbeloa]], led the prisoners in their [[Prison/Legends|cell]] in an attack against two guards they had lured inside. Outside their cell, the prisoners continued their rebellion, freeing thousands of other captives and killing the remaining Yuuzhan Vong guards, as well as the slaveship's [[Sha'kel|commander]]. With the ship now under the prisoners' control, they escaped Artorias and renamed the ship ''Heart of Artorias''.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|You have the commander's ''trust''?''"<br />"''Almost.''"<br />"''And you will ''use'' this trust against him?''"<br />"''When the time is right.|Arbeloa and Kaye Galfridian|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 3" />}}
[[File:Slaveship-Invasion1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Artorias' people are brought aboard the ''Tsam P'ah''.]]
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], intent on conquering and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaving]] its inhabitants.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> One of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that [[Battle of Artorias|fell]] to the invaders was [[Artorias]], and many of its people were [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] aboard the [[slaveship]] [[Heart of Artorias|''Tsam P'ah'']].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 1">[[Invasion 1|''Invasion'' 1]]</ref> Artorias' [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Nina Galfridian]], and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]], [[Kaye Galfridian]], were among those that were captured.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 2" /> The ''Tsam P'ah'' remained in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above Artorias, as the prisoners were to work as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on the planet's surface after it had been [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 3" />

The [[Starship/Legends|slaveship's]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Sha'kel]], wanting to put his study of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] into practice, ordered the Artorian Queen to be brought before him. As she was looking after a [[Jenny (Artorias)|wounded friend]], the Queen refused, but her daughter volunteered to go in her place. The commander told her of the Yuuzhan Vong's plans for the galaxy, and how they would teach the galaxy about [[True Way|pain]]. To illustrate his point, Sha'Kel stabbed her in the shoulder. Back among the other prisoners, Kaye found that her mother's friend had [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 2" /> Later, Nina Galfridian fell in a catatonic state due to the previous loss of her [[Caled Galfridian|husband]], [[Finn Galfridian|son]], and planet.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 3" />

Through her conversations with the slaveship's commander, Galfridian slowly gained his trust. However, she secretly worked on a plan to strike against her captors. [[Arbeloa]], the last survivor of a [[Cilare (species)|warrior species]] that had been [[Battle of Vonak|wiped out]] by the Yuuzhan Vong, was one the people who was eager to fight with her, in exchange for Sha'kel's head. He worked on overcoming his bonds to aid her when the [[Time/Legends|time]] for a revolt was right.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 3" />

==The revolt==
{{Quote|It's lucky you like pain. Because this is going to ''hurt''.|Kaye Galfridian, to Commander Sha'kel|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" />}}
Meanwhile, on Artorias' surface, the [[Artorias resistance]] had been working to disrupt the planet's Vongforming. Many of the Yuuzhan Vong sentries were killed, and the ''Tsam P'ah'' landed on the planet to deliver reinforcements. Realizing that this was a perfect moment to strike, Galfridian and Arbeloa set their plan into motion. Acting as though Arbeloa had captured Galfridian&mdash;the commander's pet&mdash;and wanted to trade her for his freedom, they managed to lure two Yuuzhan Vong guards into their [[Prison/Legends|cell]]. The two guards realized too late that they had walked into a trap, as the entire population of the cell attacked them. The pair of guards killed and wounded many prisoners, but they were eventually overpowered.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 4">[[Invasion 4|''Invasion'' 4]]</ref> After the battle, Galfridian placed two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|women]] in charge of her catatonic mother and had the [[Limb/Legends|arm]] of one the guards brought to her by another prisoner. Using the device attached to the guard's arm, Galfridian opened their cell.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" />

Before venturing forth, Arbeloa and some other prisoners created weapons by breaking off parts of their surroundings. Outside their cell, the prisoners continued fighting the Yuuzhan Vong guards and opening other cells, freeing thousands of other captives. Many of the prisoners died in the struggle, but with their superiority in numbers, they eventually managed to overcome their captors. After all the guards had been killed, Galfridian led Arbeloa to the ship's command center to make good on her promise: Sha'kel's head.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" /> Arbeloa cut off the commander's head and would later fashion it into a [[Hat/Legends|hat]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Rescues 1" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We have a ship full of people who we must see safe. And something else&mdash;we have a ship capable of helping other refugees of this war.|Nina Galfridian|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" />}}
[[File:Cognition_Throne.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Queen assumes command of the ''Tsam P'ah''.]]
With all the Yuuzhan Vong dead, the prisoners were in charge of the slaveship. They were not safe, however, as the Yuuzhan Vong still had a substantial [[Army/Legends|army]] stationed on the planet. The Queen, having recovered from her catatonic state after noticing the resistance on Artorias and realizing that her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] was still alive, assumed command of the ship through the [[cognition throne]] that Commander Sha'kel had used earlier. She [[Darkspace|jumped]] the ship away from Artorias to help other refugees of the Yuuzhan Vong War,<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" /> and the ship, renamed ''Heart of Artorias'', eventually arrived at a [[Battle of Dibrook|battle]] over the planet [[Dibrook]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Rescues 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The revolt first appeared in the [[Invasion 4|fourth issue]] of the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Invasion|''Invasion'']],<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 4" /> which was released on [[October 7]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54254/star_wars_invasion_2009_4|text=Star Wars: Invasion (2009) #4}}</ref>
